summary.headline: Kwality guides FY27 sales above INR700 crores at 26-27% EBITDA margin; Q1 gross margin 53% and receivable days 208 with recovery targeted to 165-170.
summary.overview: Management, represented solely by CFO Aditya Arora, reiterated FY27 sales guidance of above INR700 crores with 26-27% EBITDA margin and said new registrations are arriving at two to three per quarter. Oncology share was about 20% in the quarter, below the 25-30% range management now guides, with registrations delayed to Q4 FY27. Gross margin stood at 53%, down from 56-57% in the prior quarter, which management attributed to the ROW-market mix. Working capital remains stretched with receivable days at 208, which management expects to fall to 165-170 by year-end. Capex of about INR185-190 crores is to be funded from internal accruals, with the hormone plant due November 2026.

financial_highlights.change: expected to fall to 165-170 days by end FY27

financial_highlights.value: INR195 crores; management now cites INR185-190 crores

segments.name: Oncology
segments.commentary: Oncology share about 20% in Q1 FY27 vs 25-30% guided; oncology revenue INR30-35 crores in the quarter, with FY27 target of about INR100-110 crores retained. Expansion adds 45-50% capacity after completion by March 2027 and is said to be commercialisable immediately under existing registrations.

segments.name: General facility (generics)
segments.commentary: Management says 60-70 registrations were received over the last three quarters, mainly in MENA and LATAM (Mexico, Algeria, Morocco, Tunisia); Mexico had 70 submissions with 18-19 approved. Utilisation 75-80%; machinery and area extension to add at least 20% capacity.

segments.name: Biologicals (Unit 5)
segments.commentary: Erythropoietin pre-clinical complete and clinical trials expected to begin Nov/Dec 2026; Indian sales targeted in FY28 at INR80-100 crores, with ROW filings in 10-12 countries. 500 litre bioreactor installed but CDSCO approval pending, only 100 litre approved.

segments.name: Hormones (Unit 6)
segments.commentary: Plant commissioning expected by November 2026; manufacturing licence in November followed by about six months stability. Immediate ROW/tender sales of INR70-80 crores in FY28; INR150-200 crores targeted in FY29 after COPP and BE studies, and the company is treating this as FY30 in its guidance.

segments.name: Cephalosporin and beta-lactam
segments.commentary: Utilisation roughly 20-25%; management expects these combined to contribute 10-15% of FY30 revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 sales above INR700 crores, EBITDA margin 26-27%; management says INR700-720 crores is achievable this year.

FY28 growth guided at 25-30% with 25% as minimum; target of about INR1,000 crores revenue at 29-30% EBITDA margin, and INR1,500 crores by FY30 (management also said FY29 possible if hormone and biologics register on time).
Gross margin expected to improve each quarter to 49-51% at INR700 crores+ revenue and about 47% once BE and niche injectables scale.
Bioequivalence programme of 40 oral solid molecules: 6-7 commercialisable by end FY27, remaining 32 filed by Q1 FY28; INR80-100 crores from BE in FY28 and INR400-500 crores in FY29.
Keytruda biosimilar: pre-clinical to start Dec 2026, clinical trials 1-1.5 years, commercialisation targeted before end CY28.
New global auditor KPMG expected in Q3 or Q4 FY27, pending software upgrades and an EGM.
capex_capacity: Capex breakup given: hormone about INR70 crores, oncology INR50 crores, BE INR25-30 crores, working capital INR20 crores, biosimilar R&D INR10-15 crores; total INR185-190 crores.
Biosimilar clinical trials need about INR150 crores between Q3 FY28 and Q4 FY29.
Hormone plant to finish November 2026; oncology expansion capex to finish by March 2027.
Extended loan sanctioned but unused; INR15-20 crores might be drawn only if cash flow is disrupted.
Capacity utilisation: general facility 75-80%, oncology existing facility 75-80%, cephalosporin and beta-lactam 20-25%, biologicals not commercialised.
demand_pricing: Revenue mix: about 35-40% from ROW markets currently; FY30 mix envisaged at 35% LATAM, 15-20% MENA, 10-15% GCC, 10-15% Europe, with India returning after biosimilar trials.
Management claims low competition in LATAM for injectable registrations and a 200-250 product portfolio target across 70-80 countries.
Raw materials: 80-85% domestic API procurement, 15% from China; no major disruptions reported.
Receivables: about 40% of revenue at 165-170 days; payment cycles from MENA, CIS and GCC improving with recent collections.
Related party: Deepak Bansal (business associate) and Mana Pharma/SD Biopharmaceuticals linked; Kaler Biopharma's proposed oncology plant on hold and the associated land may be sold or re-arranged.

qa_highlights.question: Why did oncology fall to 20% of mix from 26%, and is the 30% target still in place?
qa_highlights.answer: Oncology guided to 25-30% as registrations slipped to Q4 FY27; general-facility registrations from MENA and LATAM were received in the last two quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Will the 40% growth continue into FY28, and what margin path leads to 30% in FY29?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects 25-30% annual growth with 25% as the floor, targets about INR1,000 crores at 29-30% EBITDA margin and doubling of revenue by end FY30.

qa_highlights.question: How will the BE programme, hormone plant and biologics convert into revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: BE: INR80-100 crores in FY28 and INR400-500 crores in FY29; hormones INR70-80 crores in FY28 and INR200 crores by FY29; FY30 totals exclude biologicals and hormones in the guidance base.

qa_highlights.question: Why is gross margin 53%, and where will it go?
qa_highlights.answer: Mix reflects 35-40% ROW sales; management expects 49-51% at INR700 crores+ and about 47% as BE products scale.

qa_highlights.question: How will capex be funded and what is the breakup?
qa_highlights.answer: Funded from internal accruals with extended loan undrawn; INR185-190 crores total including INR70 crores hormone, INR50 crores oncology and INR150 crores for biosimilar trials through FY29.

qa_highlights.question: Governance: when will the new auditor be appointed?
qa_highlights.answer: KPMG to be appointed in Q3 or Q4 FY27 via EGM, pending software upgrades; agreement already filed.

risks_watch: Oncology registrations slipped to Q4 FY27; oncology share of mix was about 20% vs 25-30% guided, and the INR100-110 crore FY27 oncology target depends on those registrations.
Receivable days at 208 vs a 165-170 target by end FY27; management cited MENA, CIS and GCC payment delays, and about 40% of revenue sits in receivables.

Biologicals and hormones are excluded from the FY27 and FY28 guidance base, and the 500 litre bioreactor awaits CDSCO approval (only 100 litre approved). Hormone revenue timing depends on the BE studies and the November 2026 manufacturing licence.
Governance: KPMG appointment is planned for Q3 or Q4 FY27 but depends on software upgrades and an EGM. An analyst questioned this timing, and the existing auditor's tenure was recently extended.

Related-party items: Kaler Biopharma oncology plant is on hold, the associated land may be sold or re-arranged, and Mana Pharma/SD Biopharmaceuticals ties persist. Gross margin guided to recover to 49-51% but was 53% in Q1 vs 56-57% in the prior quarter.
key_quotes: Oncology will be roughly between 25% to 30% considering the timelines for getting the oncology registrations will be, getting a little delayed.
But this financial year, we do believe that 100% the sales will cross the INR700 crores or INR720 crores mark.
So we have taken these sales into consideration from FY30.
Probably we'll plan something sir. As of now we had certain money in Q3 of FY26, where we did some purchase from the market, but probably we will plan something.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident and forward-leaning on FY27 sales above INR700 crores and FY30 INR1,500 crores, but became cautious and hedged on timing, repeatedly citing regulatory delays and registration dependence. It was evasive on the Kaler Biopharma and land arrangement and on promoter stake plans, and gave no firm answer on the gross margin or receivables trajectory beyond targets.

growth.why: FY27 sales guided at above INR700 crore (INR700-720 crore) with capacity utilisation at 75-80% and oncology, general and hormone capacity additions due by March 2027 and November 2026, but Q1 gross margin fell to 53%, oncology share was about 20% vs 25-30% guidance, and receivable days remain at 208, which tempers the outlook.
